Sub-field-address vector field-pun — `(CVector3f *)&CStack_270.z` casts the address of a non-first component of a vector to a vector pointer, so a 3-component access starts mid-vector and overruns `CStack_270` by 4-8 bytes (ASan stack-buffer-overflow; §26). Introduce a real contiguous CVector3f local, write all 3 components (recover dropped writes from the .asm), and pass its address.
